Around [[33 BBY]], a '''group''' of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]]. The [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service to the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] engaged the pirates, putting the new [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] to the test.
